title: Most news feeds are broken because they treat everyone the same.
body:
When you open a typical news app, you get a firehose of information. It is designed to capture attention, not to inform. You end up scrolling past dozens of stories that just do not matter to your life or your work.

We think news should be different. Personalisation should not mean just showing you more of what you already click on. That creates an echo chamber. True personalisation means filtering out the noise so you can find the signals that actually help you make better decisions.

Technology allows us to curate a feed that respects your time. It should be about giving you the full picture on the topics you care about, while skipping the fluff that is only there to keep you scrolling. Good AI acts like a smart editor, not a click-hungry algorithm.
cta: If you want to see how we are building a better way to stay informed, come take a look at HEADLINNE.com.
